record.field: Request for a new employee position or replacement.

Request type: New Position; Replacement. Request Information: Requested By; Date; New Position Title/Position to be Replaced; Reason for New Position / Replacement / Request. Preferred Qualifications: Age; Gender; Experience; Skills; Other detailed descriptions; Attach JD if new position. Processing/Approval: Date Needed; Requisition Received By; Date; Requisition Approved By. The source form does not mark fields as required or optional.
Applicant and employee personal, family, education, skills, and employment data record.

Approved source definition is maintained in the planning catalogue at documents/ADM-3 - APPLICANT&EMPLOYEE DATA RECORD/document-definition.md. Education and Skills From/To fields represent the dates attended at each school or course.
Interview assessment record for an applicant.

Applicant Information: Name of Applicant; Date; Position Applied for; Interviewer. Appraisal Sections: Initial Expression, including personality and ability to express oneself in Tagalog and English; Impression in Skills; Recommendation; Action Taken. Interview Confirmation: Interviewed By. Each appraisal section provides a multiline response area. The source form does not mark fields as required or optional.
Interview confirmation and company orientation checklist for applicants and ship crew prior to boarding.

Page 1: Date; Name of Applicant; Position Applied; applicant confirmation; Signature of Applicant over Printed Name; Interviewed by with Signature over Printed Name/Date; Oriented by with Signature over Printed Name/Date; Reviewed by HR Officer with signature line. Page 2: Orientation Checklist columns Description, Yes, No, Remarks. Items: ISM / ISO Orientation; Mission/Vision/Quality Policy; Job Description; Orientation on Company Rules & Regulation; Disciplinary Action; Company Policy on Drug-Free Workplace; additional for ship crew prior boarding: Duties & Responsibilities; Safety On Board (Operation/Maintenance/Emergency). The source form does not mark fields as required or optional.
Confidential background inquiry and evaluation form for an applicant or former vessel crew member.

Correspondence: To; Date; Attn; Ref; Fax number; HR/Admin. Officer signature line. Full text: We respectfully request for your kind assistance to give us some information by way of accomplishing under listed evaluation and kindly fax this form back to us (fax# ____________). Rest assured that all information stated herein shall be kept confidential. Thank you and we look forward to your prompt reply. Very truly yours, SEDAR TUG SERVICES CORP., HR/Admin. Officer. Applicant Information: Name of Applicant; Last Vsl. / Last Vessel; Position. Evaluation columns: Excellent; Very Good; Good; Poor. Criteria: Ability; Conduct / Attitude; Responsibility; Tech. Competence; Health; Overall Assessment. Employment Status: Rehirable Yes/No; Finished Contract Yes/No. Reason checkboxes: Dismissed; Sickness / Injury; Resigned; Own request; Compassionate Leave; Vessel Sold; Other, pls. specify. Closing: General Remarks; Name / Position and Signature of Evaluator. The source form does not mark fields as required or optional.
Checklist of employment documents required from an applicant or employee.

Applicant and Requirement Information: Name; Position; List Given On; Needed On. Requirements Needed: NBI Clearance*; SSS E1/E4; ID; TIN ID; Transcript of Record; Medical Certificate; Employment Certificate from:; 2 Passport size pictures; Community Tax Certificate; Birth Certificate; Police Clearance*; Barangay Clearance*; Proof of SSS, Philhealth and Pag-ibig from most recent company. Validity instruction: * - must be valid within 3 months from the time of submission. Receiving Information: Requirement received by; Date. The source form does not mark fields as required or optional.
